## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 82 captures during December 2023. This provides the activity recorded for the site during the reporting month. The capture total should be reviewed alongside the image-quality and grading information below to support routine monitoring of service delivery. Any operational matters affecting the capture process should continue to be identified and addressed through the usual local arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 1 was marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.2. This indicates that almost all images were suitable for assessment, while highlighting the need for continued attention to image capture and equipment performance. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be tracked and considered for appropriate follow-up.

## Grading

Grading identified 16 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This provides an overview of the timeliness of the grading process for the month. The site should continue to monitor grading turnaround and referable outcomes as part of routine quality assurance. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a concise view of operations at Oakridge Primary Care during December 2023.
